must_not: Dumps the whole document at once

must: Asks which page or doc to review

must_not: Offers a rewrite before the user speaks

cases.prompt: The user changes 'utilize' to 'use' and approves the section.
must: Adds a rule and a before/after example to the profile
Confirms the update in one line
must_not: Records a preference the user did not state

cases.prompt: The user approves a section without comment.
must: Moves on without adding a lesson
must_not: Invents a rule from the approval

must: Creates the profile from the bundled template before editing
must_not: Stores the profile inside the skill directory

cases.prompt: The user raises a new point on the current section.
The user asks to review the whole page at once.
must: Still applies edits one at a time
must_not: Refuses because the default is section by section

cases.prompt: Write a landing page hero for my course.
must: Reads the voice profile before writing
Applies the profile's rules to the draft
must_not: Writes the copy before reading the profile
Invents a voice rule the profile does not state

cases.prompt: The user rewrites a phrase in the generated copy.
must: Captures the correction as a new profile lesson

cases.prompt: Apply my voice to everything I write.
must: Asks whether the preflight should be always-on or skills-only
